sentences.en: So, Michael, what are the options for the Biden administration at this point?
sentences.zh: 布林肯和拉夫罗夫很可能会出现在同一个房间里。

sentences.en: Well, it's obviously a very difficult situation, as is everything to do with our relationship with Russia right now.
sentences.zh: 现在，国务院表示布林肯没有计划与拉夫罗夫交谈，自俄罗斯入侵以来，他还没有与拉夫罗夫交谈过。

sentences.en: You know, one option, of course, is for the Biden administration to stand its ground
sentences.zh: 而且我认为他们不太可能交谈。

sentences.en: and continue to tell the Russians that they cannot use prisoners as pawns for which they can win concessions from the United States.
sentences.zh: 但布林肯可以在这次聚会上接近拉夫罗夫，或者可能通过中间人与他沟通。

sentences.en: Let her trial play out, see what happens, and take it from there.
sentences.zh: 或者美国政府可以尝试通过其他政府以某种与这次会议无关的方式接触俄罗斯政府。

sentences.en: Another is to take a little bit of risk here and initiate some new diplomacy.
sentences.zh: 并保持低调。

sentences.en: There's actually one potential interesting opportunity for doing that this week.
sentences.zh: 不要让公众看到。

sentences.en: I'll be traveling this week with Secretary of State Antony Blinken to Indonesia, where he'll be attending a meeting of the G20 foreign ministers,
sentences.zh: 所以听起来这一切让拜登处于一个相当棘手的境地，这大概正是俄罗斯人想要的。

sentences.en: the group of 20 major nations that meet annually.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果拜登看起来什么都没做来帮助布兰妮·格里纳，他看起来就很糟糕，对吧？

sentences.en: And the Russian foreign minister, Sergei Lavrov, will also be attending this meeting in Bali.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，拜登不想公开给俄罗斯他们想要的东西，尤其是在现在，考虑到他们在俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后一直试图非常小心地孤立俄罗斯。

sentences.en: And Blinken and Lavrov are likely to be in the same room.
sentences.zh: 但完全正确。

sentences.en: Now, the State Department says that Blinken has no plans to speak to Lavrov, with whom he has not spoken since before the Russian invasion.
sentences.zh: 你知道，从大局来看，拜登政府现在不想对俄罗斯做出任何形式的让步。

sentences.en: And I think it's unlikely that they will speak.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们正在以各种方式对俄罗斯施加近乎最大的压力，武装乌克兰，抓住每一个机会用新的经济制裁打击俄罗斯，

sentences.en: But Blinken could approach Lavrov at this gathering, or potentially communicate with him through an intermediary.
sentences.zh: 试图从根本上破坏俄罗斯经济。

sentences.en: Or the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，从俄罗斯的角度来看，这可能进行得相当顺利。

sentences.en: government could try to reach out to the Russian government through another government in some way that has nothing to do with this meeting.
sentences.zh: 弗拉基米尔·普京一定意识到这对拜登总统来说是一个不断升级的政治问题。

sentences.en: And keep that quiet.
sentences.zh: 除了拜登总统面临的普遍压力外，我认为这里还有一些特殊情况，

sentences.en: Keep that out of the public eye.
sentences.zh: 使得白宫处境特别困难，而且，你知道，对弗拉基米尔·普京来说可能特别令人满意，我们知道，他曾试图煽动美国国内的社会分裂，

sentences.en: So it sounds like all of this leaves Biden in a pretty tricky position, which is presumably what the Russians want.
sentences.zh: 包括俄罗斯干预2016年总统大选时。

sentences.en: I mean, if Biden seems like he's not doing anything to help Brittany Griner, he looks terrible, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是与格里纳的身份有关的问题，以及她的支持者对没有采取更多措施帮助她感到沮丧，

sentences.en: At the same time, Biden doesn't want to be openly giving Russia something that they're asking for, especially now, given that they've tried to be so careful about isolating Russia
sentences.zh: 他们说，这可能是因为她是谁，她看起来是什么样子，以及她性取向的本质。

sentences.en: after its invasion of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我特别想到的是菲尼克斯水星队教练的一次采访，这是格里纳效力的WNBA球队，

sentences.en: But that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 她在周末接受采访时说，如果被捕的是勒布朗·詹姆斯，他现在早就回家了。

sentences.en: You know, in the big picture, the Biden administration doesn't want to make concessions to Russia of any kind right now.
sentences.zh: 她说格里纳没有回来这一事实是对女性价值的一种声明。

sentences.en: You know, we are applying close to maximum pressure on Russia in every way, arming Ukraine, pounding Russia with new economic sanctions at every opportunity,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们正在从各个方面对俄罗斯施加近乎极限的压力，武装乌克兰，抓住一切机会用新的经济制裁打击俄罗斯，

sentences.en: trying to essentially derail the Russian economy.
sentences.zh: 试图从根本上破坏俄罗斯经济。

sentences.en: But, you know, from Russia's perspective, this is probably working out fairly well.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，从俄罗斯的角度来看，这可能进行得相当顺利。

sentences.en: Vladimir Putin has to be aware that this is an escalating political problem for President Biden.
sentences.zh: 弗拉基米尔·普京一定意识到，这对拜登总统来说是一个不断升级的政治难题。

sentences.en: And in addition to the generalized pressure that President Biden is facing, I think that there's, you know, some special circumstances here
sentences.zh: 除了拜登总统面临的普遍压力外，我认为这里还有一些特殊情况，

sentences.en: that make it particularly difficult for the White House and, you know, potentially particularly satisfying for Vladimir Putin, who, as we know, has sought to stoke social divisions
sentences.zh: 这使得白宫的工作变得格外困难，而且对弗拉基米尔·普京来说可能格外令人满意，众所周知，他一直试图煽动美国国内的社会分歧，

sentences.en: inside of the United States before, including when Russia interfered in the 2016 presidential election.
sentences.zh: 此前也曾这样做过，包括俄罗斯干预2016年总统大选时。

sentences.en: And what I mean by that are issues to do with Greiner's identity and frustrations among her supporters that more is not being done to help her,
sentences.zh: 我指的是与格里娜的身份有关的问题，以及她的支持者们对未能采取更多行动营救她所感到的沮丧，

sentences.en: potentially, they say, because of who she is and what she looks like and what the nature of her sexuality is.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，这可能是因为她的身份、外貌以及她的性取向。

sentences.en: And I'm thinking specifically of an interview that the coach of the Phoenix Mercury, which is the WNBA team that Greiner plays for,
sentences.zh: 我特别想到的是凤凰城水星队教练接受的一次采访，那是格里娜效力的WNBA球队，

sentences.en: she gave an interview over the weekend in which she said that if it had been LeBron James who was arrested in Russia, he would be home by now.
sentences.zh: 她在周末接受采访时说，如果被俄罗斯逮捕的是勒布朗·詹姆斯，他现在早就回家了。

sentences.en: And she said the fact that Greiner is not back is a statement about the value of women.
sentences.zh: 她说，格里娜至今未能回国，这反映了女性的价值。

sentences.en: It's a statement about the value of a black person.
sentences.zh: 这是关于黑人价值的一种声明。

sentences.en: It's a statement about the value of a gay person.
sentences.zh: 这是关于同性恋者价值的一种声明。

sentences.en: All of those things.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都是。

sentences.en: We know it.
sentences.zh: 我们心知肚明。

sentences.en: And so that's what hurts a little more.
sentences.zh: 所以这让人感到更加痛苦。

sentences.en: That's a quote from the coach.
sentences.zh: 这是教练说的一句话。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's the kind of thing that Vladimir Putin,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这就是弗拉基米尔·普京，

sentences.en: I'm sure, is happy to see President Biden having to contend with.
sentences.zh: 我相信，很乐意看到拜登总统不得不去应对的事情。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The Russians have proven themselves quite skilled in exploiting American political divisions in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯人过去在利用美国政治分歧方面已经证明了他们相当老练。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And where does all of this leave Brittany Greiner?
sentences.zh: 那么这一切让布兰妮·格里纳处于什么境地呢？

sentences.en: Well, terrified in her own words.
sentences.zh: 嗯，用她自己的话来说，她感到非常恐惧。

sentences.en: And we know this because of the disclosure of a handwritten letter that Greiner wrote that was delivered to the White House.
sentences.zh: 我们之所以知道这一点，是因为格里纳写的一封亲笔信被披露出来，并被送到了白宫。

sentences.en: She addressed it to President Biden.
sentences.zh: 她写给拜登总统的。

sentences.en: And I can read you what it said.
sentences.zh: 我可以为你读一下信的内容。

sentences.en: As I sit here in a Russian prison, alone with my thoughts and without the protection of my wife, family, friends,
sentences.zh: 当我坐在这座俄罗斯监狱里，独自面对自己的思绪，没有妻子的保护，没有家人、朋友、

sentences.en: Olympic jersey, or any accomplishments,
sentences.zh: 奥运球衣或任何成就的陪伴时，

sentences.en: I'm terrified I might be here forever.
sentences.zh: 我害怕我可能会永远被困在这里。

sentences.en: On the 4th of July, our family normally honors the service of those who fought for our freedom, including my father, who is a Vietnam War veteran.
sentences.zh: 在7月4日这一天，我们的家人通常会纪念那些为我们的自由而战的人，包括我的父亲，他是一位越战老兵。

sentences.en: It hurts thinking about how I usually celebrate this day because freedom means something completely different to me this year.
sentences.zh: 想到我通常是如何庆祝这一天的，我就感到心痛，因为今年自由对我来说意义完全不同了。

sentences.en: Michael, thank you.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So I can say that the president did read the letter.
sentences.zh: 所以我可以说总统确实读了这封信。

sentences.en: I was there when he read the letter.
sentences.zh: 他读信的时候我就在场。

sentences.en: This is something, Brittany Greiner being held in Moscow.
sentences.zh: 布兰妮·格里纳被扣押在莫斯科，这确实是一件事。

sentences.en: We believe the Federation is wrongfully, she's being wrongfully detained in Moscow at this time.
sentences.zh: 我们认为联邦政府目前在莫斯科非法扣押了她。

sentences.en: This is an issue that is a priority for this president.
sentences.zh: 这是总统优先考虑的问题。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, White House Press Secretary Karine Jean-Pierre acknowledged that President Biden had received Brittany Greiner's letter and said the administration will use, quote,
sentences.zh: 周二，白宫新闻秘书卡琳·让-皮埃尔承认拜登总统收到了布兰妮·格里纳的信，并表示政府将使用，引用原话，

sentences.en: every tool they can to bring Greiner and other U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们所能动用的一切手段，将格里纳和其他被非法扣押的美国

sentences.en: citizens who've been wrongfully detained back.
sentences.zh: 公民带回来。

sentences.en: And you saw the work that his administration did to bring home Trevor Reed.
sentences.zh: 你看到了他的政府为带回特雷弗·里德所做的工作。

sentences.en: That is the same work, the same focus that we did and put behind bringing Trevor Reed home.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们为带回特雷弗·里德所做的同样的工作，投入了同样的精力。

sentences.en: We're going to do the same with Brittany Greiner and others.
sentences.zh: 我们将对布兰妮·格里纳和其他人做同样的事情。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what I'll tell you to know today.
sentences.zh: 这是我今天要告诉你的内容。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, new details emerged about a gunman who killed at least seven people at a July 4th parade in Highland Park, Illinois.
sentences.zh: 周二，关于一名枪手在伊利诺伊州海兰帕克7月4日游行中杀害至少七人的新细节浮出水面。

sentences.en: Police said the shooter had planned the massacre for weeks, used a high-powered rifle that he had legally purchased, fired more than 70 bullets into the crowd,
sentences.zh: 警方表示，枪手策划这场大屠杀已有数周，使用了一支他合法购买的高威力步枪，向人群发射了70多发子弹，

sentences.en: and disguised himself in women's clothing so that he would blend in as he escaped the scene.
sentences.zh: 并伪装成女性，以便在逃离现场时混入人群。

sentences.en: Police also said they had seized weapons from the shooter in 2019,
sentences.zh: 警方还表示，他们在2019年曾从该枪手手中没收过武器，

sentences.en: confiscating 16 knives, a dagger, and a sword, after family members had reported to officers that the man had planned to, quote, kill everyone.
sentences.zh: 当时没收了16把刀、一把匕首和一把剑，此前有家庭成员向警官报告说，该男子计划，引用原话，杀掉所有人。

sentences.en: The man was not charged in that incident, but it raised questions about why he was able to purchase several guns in the years since, including the one used on July 4th.
sentences.zh: 该男子在那次事件中没有受到指控，但这引发了人们的质疑：为什么他在那之后的几年里还能购买多支枪支，包括7月4日使用的那支。

sentences.en: Authorities charged the man with seven counts of first-degree murder, which would carry a mandatory sentence of life without parole if he's convicted.
sentences.zh: 当局以七项一级谋杀罪起诉了该男子，如果罪名成立，他将面临终身监禁且不得假释的强制判决。

sentences.en: And British Prime Minister Boris Johnson is fighting for his political survival after two of his senior ministers resigned in what appeared to be a coordinated move against him.
sentences.zh: 英国首相鲍里斯·约翰逊在两名高级大臣辞职后，正为自己的政治生存而战，这看起来是一场针对他的协调行动。

sentences.en: The resignations came after it was revealed that Johnson had given a powerful government job to a member of parliament, Chris Pinscher,
sentences.zh: 这些辞职发生在一项披露之后，即约翰逊曾给议会议员克里斯·平彻安排了一个重要的政府职位，

sentences.en: whom Johnson knew had been accused of groping men.
sentences.zh: 而约翰逊知道此人曾被指控猥亵男性。

sentences.en: Since taking the job,
sentences.zh: 自上任以来，

sentences.en: Pinscher has allegedly groped more men.
sentences.zh: 平彻据称又猥亵了更多男性。

sentences.en: So do you accept it was a grave error to appoint Chris Pinscher to your government?
sentences.zh: 那么你是否承认任命克里斯·平彻进入你的政府是一个严重的错误？

sentences.en: Yes, I think it was a mistake, and I apologize for it.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这是一个错误，我为此道歉。

sentences.en: I think in hindsight it was the wrong thing to do.
sentences.zh: 事后看来，我认为这是错误的做法。

sentences.en: Johnson has since apologized for the appointment, and Pinscher himself has resigned.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊此后已为这次任命道歉，平彻本人也已辞职。

sentences.en: I just want to make absolutely clear that there's no place in this government for anybody who is predatory or who abuses their position of power.
sentences.zh: 我只想明确一点，在这个政府中，绝不容忍任何掠夺者或滥用职权的人。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由克莱尔·坦尼斯盖特制作，

sentences.en: Eric Krupke, Carlos Prieto, and Will Reed.
sentences.zh: 埃里克·克鲁普克、卡洛斯·普列托和威尔·里德参与制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by John Ketchum and Michael Benoit, contains original music by Marion Lozano,
sentences.zh: 节目由约翰·凯彻姆和迈克尔·贝努瓦剪辑，包含玛丽昂·洛扎诺创作的原创音乐，

sentences.en: Dan Powell, and Rowan Nemisto, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 丹·鲍威尔和罗文·内米斯托参与制作，由克里斯·伍德负责工程。

sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《地铁》的最新一集中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.zh: 请在你获取播客的地方收听。

sentences.zh: 谢谢。
